events.title: Mission Inn Festival of Lights
events.blurb: Millions of lights on the Mission Inn and downtown, with Santa, food and entertainment Thursday–Sunday.
events.blurbEs: Millones de luces en el Mission Inn y el centro, con Santa, comida y espectáculos de jueves a domingo.

events.title: Festival of Lights ice rink
events.blurb: Outdoor skating downtown every night of the festival.
events.blurbEs: Patinaje al aire libre en el centro todas las noches del festival.

events.title: Holiday Magic at Candy Lane
events.blurb: A candy-themed holiday walk-through for kids, opening this weekend.
events.blurbEs: Un recorrido navideño con temática de dulces para niños, que abre este fin de semana.
